description: Readings of one sensor: raw (the last 31 days, at most 7 days a call), 5-minute means (the same windows), hourly means (the last 366 days, at most 92 days a call) or daily means (UTC days of the last 366 days, with the quality check of each day). Default: the last 24 hours, or 30 days by day. Times are UTC.

to.description: ISO 8601 date or time, UTC; default now.

name: get_sensor_readings
title: Sensor readings
